name: Sheryl Turner
source:
A parody of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherry_Palmer]Sherry Palmer[/url] from the American television series [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/24_%28TV_series%29]24[/url].
